prompt:
You are an experienced sommelier comparing two wine recommenders. A
customer with no wine knowledge made this request:

"Do you have any light, a little sweet wine that tastes like green apple and spices, with a warming feel for a romantic dinner? I am curious and want to try something new."

List A:
Wine 1: Portuguese White, Portugal, $10. Tasting note: "Spicy and light at heart, this is a perfumed wine that the winemaker reckons will go with Asian food. Apples, a touch of green herbs and peaches abound in this refreshing, drinkable wine. Drink now."
Wine 2: Rosé, France, $13. Tasting note: "With only the lightest texture, this wine almost tastes like a white wine. It has plenty of citrus character, partnered with apple and green-fruit flavors. At the end, look out for the bite of tannin that gives it a more rosé character."
Wine 3: Chardonnay, France, $30. Tasting note: "Spiced-apple aromas lead to a soft, perfumed wine that has a crisp, fruity edge. The apple and green-plum flavors give attractive acidity. Drink now."
Wine 4: Portuguese White, Portugal, price unknown. Tasting note: "This crisp and fresh wine suggests citrus and green apple fruits. It is light, fragrant and ready to drink with its bright final acidity."
Wine 5: Sparkling Blend, US, $38. Tasting note: "Floral and fragrant, this lovely lighthearted sparkling wine is sublime and lemony in texture, with a bushy frothy mousse. Green apple shines brightest, with additional accents of strawberry and peach that punctuate the palate."

List B:
Wine 1: Chardonnay, France, price unknown. Tasting note: "This is an attractive light and fruity wine. It has fresh fruit flavors, with notes of crisp citrus and green apple. A touch of vanilla and a smooth texture surface as it opens up."
Wine 2: Moscato, Italy, $15. Tasting note: "Here's a fun, simple dessert wine that opens with scents of sage and citrus. The aromas carry over to the frothy palate along with lime and apricot. This would be ideal to accompany brunch or summer picnics."
Wine 3: Grüner Veltliner, Austria, price unknown. Tasting note: "Intensely rich wine that flows opulently. Rounded warm and concentrated, it has spice, pepper as well as pineapple and peach fruit. It is not sweet but the unctuous character makes it feel so. Needs at least five years in bottle."
Wine 4: Merlot, US, $26. Tasting note: "There's lots to admire in this well-ripened, elegant dinner wine. It has aromas of green olives, white chocolate, and plums, with a waft of smoky oak, while the flavors are spicy and fruity. Bone-dry, it's richly tannic and complex, with depth and interest."
Wine 5: Bordeaux-style White Blend, France, $13. Tasting note: "A light wine that seems rather dilute. It has simple, green and citrus fruit flavors that are gentle and refreshing. Drink now."

Which list answers the request better as a whole: relevance to every wish,
variety where the request leaves room, and fit for any occasion? If they
are equally good, say tie. Think briefly, then answer with JSON only:
{"reason": "<two sentences at most>", "better": "A" | "B" | "tie"}
